description: Compare pay before and after a salary sacrifice for a pension or an electric company car: income tax, National Insurance and student loan saved, employer National Insurance saved and passed back, benefit-in-kind tax for a car, the drop in take-home pay, and for a pension the cost per pound added and the saving against paying in from net pay.

carP11dValue.description: List (P11D) value of the car; electric car only

employerNIPassback.description: Share (0 to 1) of the employer NI saving added to the pension; pension only

grossSalary.description: Gross annual salary before the sacrifice

sacrificeAmount.description: Amount given up from gross pay each year

sacrificeType.description: pension, or ev-car for an electric car scheme

scottishTaxpayer.description: True for a Scottish taxpayer (Scottish bands)

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plan, if any (plan4 is Scotland, postgrad the postgraduate loan)

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.
